title: Transforming the chemical industry: a BASF perspective on net-zero and circularity
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00825E, Perspective
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bernhard von Vacano, Wolfgang Hübinger, Willis Muganda, Grigorios Kolios, Talke Schaffrannek, Alois Kindler, Kai Ehrhard, Markus Weber
The shift of the industry to non-fossil feedstocks and CO2 emission neutrality is a big task. From a BASF view, long term strategy, technology and economic pathways are discussed, to deliver on the necessary green transformation of the economy.
